# Show in Calendar

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Shows the provided event on the calendar.

## Syntax

~~~~text
showInCalendar(event: <#Variable#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
showInCalendar(event: ShortcutInput)
~~~~
